verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe a concrete in-PR fix loop: a 'Fix with your Agent' button attaches file/line/suggested-code context and launches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Devin to apply the fix, a 'Fix All' button batches this, and the flow iterates until the PR reaches a clean review score — all without leaving the PR thread. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the agent-dispatch-and-apply loop works reliably in practice (community evidence only covers review quality, not the fix-application step) and confirmation of a fully committed-patch outcome versus just handing off to an external agent.
